_doc: V1.8 head geometry in the robot frame (mm, x forward, y left, z up), copied from the head-v18 build scratchpad on 2026-10-12. These files are what build_guide_data.py draws and what interference-audit/build_solids.py audits for the listed keys. Pi group shift for this cap: PI_SHIFT [-4.6, 0, 1.0]. The V1.7 cap (PI_SHIFT [-4.6, 0, 0]) remains under print/candidates/head-cap-pi-shift/. camera_retainer is retired (no file). head_bottom.stl and head_cap.stl were mesh-cleaned for the release pipeline on 2026-10-12 (same solids; see meshClean per file); the guide and the audit must be rebuilt from these files. 2026-10-12 torso: rear_pack.stl and rear_pack_cover.stl (V1.8 rear electronics pack, from the torso-pack scratchpad), openrb-board-upright.stl, imu_board.stl and imu_sh4_receiving.stl (re-posed purchased parts) were added; openrb_tray.stl and openrb-board.stl stay as the V1.7 record and are no longer drawn. 2026-10-13 V1.9: rear_pack.stl (V1.9 pack with the BNO085 rib) and head_cap.stl (V1.9 cap with speaker collar and amplifier posts, no rear notch) replaced; the V1.8 files are kept beside them as rear_pack-v18.stl and head_cap-v18.stl (not drawn, not audited). Added: speaker_retainer.stl, clip_torso.stl, clip_bracket.stl, clip_head.stl, clip_cap.stl (new prints, print/ext-v19/), speaker.stl and amplifier.stl (purchased parts at their audio-study positions). The five amplifier-header housings are box primitives in build_guide_data.py (amp_housings), not a file. 2026-10-14 rear converter box, layout F (print/back-plate/layout-F/, V1.11; superseded layout C revision 2 of V1.10): rear_frame.stl and rear_lid.stl (new prints, orange) replace rear_pack_cover.stl as a current part (the cover file stays for the record, not drawn); xl4015_left.stl, xl4015_right.stl and pd5991.stl are the two ROBOTIS XL4015 converters and the Adafruit 5991 at their box positions. 2026-10-14 release V1.12: head_cap.stl stays the V1.9 cap (print/ext-v19/head_cap_v19-world.stl) and is reprinted white with its V1.9 closing pilots for the ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6 screws; the whole head stays M2.6 (Shawn, 2026-10-14). The V2.0 cap, lower shell and jaw frame are deferred until the head is next opened, so head_bottom.stl and jaw_frame.stl stay V1.8. 2026-10-14 V1.12 shells: shell_left.stl and shell_right.stl (white, print/v20-source/) override the full-build export shells; Shawn confirmed the V1.9 rear pack is on the robot. 2026-10-14 evening, V1.15: rear_frame.stl and rear_lid.stl replaced by the regenerated layout F build (print/back-plate/layout-F/: hidden M2 x 10 cap screw and hook instead of the two ears, solid front plate without P1, wire notches A and B at the top-wall front edge and cover-plate top edge for the 7 V and 5 V pairs that now run outside the box and over its top). 2026-10-15 Radxa Cubie A7Z head (print/a7z-head/, print/face-a7z/): head_cap.stl, clip_cap.stl, face_panel.stl and camera_board.stl replaced by the A7Z versions; the previous files are kept as head_cap-v19.stl, clip_cap-v19.stl, face_panel-v18.stl and camera_board-cm3.stl (not drawn, not audited). a7z_*.stl (board and components, a7z_pcb.stl is the guide key pi), antenna.stl, antenna_coax.stl, antenna_ipex.stl and camera_ribbon.stl are purchased parts. eye_trim.stl is unchanged.

face_panel.stl.description: Face panel for the Radxa Camera 13M 214 (2026-10-15, print/face-a7z/build_face_a7z.py): the V1.8 face with its four lands and two pegs removed and four bosses (dia 4.8, x 77.8..80.1, blind 1.7 mm pilots) at y -14.09/13.91, z 117.11/145.11; the two 2.2 mm holes now take the eye-trim screws. Front unchanged.

record.description: Face panel V1.8: flat plate x 80.1..81.4 only. Rear hex bosses, oval frame and the three clamp anchors are gone; four camera bearing lands r 2.4 (x 79.0..80.1) at (y, z) = (12.31, 120.6), (-0.18, 120.6), (12.31, 141.6), (-0.18, 141.6); two locating pegs r 1.0 (x 78.0..79.0) in the y 12.31 column, the lower one relieved to 1.6 mm along z; two 2.2 mm screw holes at (-0.18, 120.6) and (-0.18, 141.6); former oval slot and two 2.05 mm pockets filled. Feature list: face-v18-features.json in the build scratchpad. 2026-10-12: the three 0.58 mm pits left by the removed V1.6 clamp pilots at (y, z) = (-18.09, 119.0), (-18.09, 147.2), (17.91, 147.2) are filled flat (print/face-pits/fill_pits.json).

previous.note: three 0.58 mm clamp-pilot pits in the back face

eye_trim.stl.description: Eye trim V1.8: as V1.6 plus two 1.7 mm screw pilots x 81.3..87.0 at (y -0.18, z 120.6) and (y -0.18, z 141.6) for the M2 x 8 camera screws.

head_bottom.stl.description: Lower head shell V1.8: the V1.6 shell with the beak-roof window filled (no window). 2026-10-12: the 2.2 mm strip at x 71.4..73.6 that the first fill left open is closed with the shell's own adjacent roof slab (print/head-bottom-strip/close_strip.json). 2026-10-12 (later): the upper lip pad (source p.obj / ID40) is printed as part of the shell instead of being glued in, with a 5.2 mm driver hole under each front closure screw (print/head-bottom-pad/merge_pad.json).

previous.meshClean: Release-pipeline mesh clean of the same solid on 2026-10-12: vertices merged at 1e-4 mm, degenerate and duplicate triangles dropped; volume unchanged (23530.5 mm3). The scratchpad source file is the pre-clean export.

previousStripClosed.note: strip closed, separate glued upper pad

head_cap.stl.description: Head cap for the Radxa Cubie A7Z (2026-10-15, print/a7z-head/build_a7z_head.py): the V1.9 cap with the board rails relieved 1.6 mm except r 3 mm pads at the four holes, a +Y end slot for the camera connector and ribbon and a -Y end slot for the microSD card (327.1 mm3 removed, closed volume). Same pilots, same seat, same V1.9 print pose.

record.description: Head cap V1.9 (print/ext-v19/, 2026-10-13): the V1.8 cap with the rear notch and its hood closed (the seat band against head_bottom grows from 63.0 to 67.5 mm3, intended), a speaker collar in the rear roof with two dia 1.7 retainer pilots (H-speaker_retainer-01/02), two amplifier posts on the flat top-centre strip (H-amplifier-01/02), and the Pi rails unchanged (E-pi-01..03 as V1.8; E-pi-04 becomes M2 x 8 because the cap wire clip tab sits under its head). Print pose: the V1.8 pose, roof on the bed, 4 mm outer brim (manifest-ext-v19.json). Keeps the V1.8 Bambu support blocker for the E-pi-04 pilot.

previous.note: V1.8 cap: rear cable notch with hood and two zip-tie slots, no audio posts. Its replaces/audioPostsRemoved history is in git.

record.v112Reprint: Release V1.12 reprints this exact V1.9 cap (same STL, same pose, same closing pilots for ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6) in white; the orange V1.9 print becomes a spare.

camera_board.stl.description: Radxa Camera 13M 214 as boxes (PCB 32 x 32 x 1.6 with holes, lens holder, back component layer, lens-side FPC connector on the +Y edge, ribbon stub folding back at y 33), lens on the eye axis (y -0.09, z 131.11), PCB x 76.2..77.8.

record.description: Camera Module 3 Wide turned 180 degrees about its lens axis (y -0.09, z 131.11): FFC connector on the -y side (y -9.55..-3.84, x 75.13..77.88); PCB back face x 79.0 on the face lands; board holes at the four land centres. The autofocus body (camera_af-flip180-world.stl, 31.7 mm3) is not part of the guide camera part, as before.

rear_pack.stl.description: Rear electronics pack V1.9 (body), 2026-10-13: as V1.8 (front plate with the power-support silhouette and the four hip-yaw case-screw tabs, upright OpenRB-150 bay on four pads, DFR1202 channel, +y wall window, USB-C and tether openings, two rear cover posts) with the BNO085 edge slot and tie shelf replaced by a rib on the plate front carrying two dia 1.6 pilots at (x -15.46, z 8.04) and (x -15.46, z 28.36): the board back lies flat on the rib face and two M2 x 4 (I-imu_rib-01/02) hold it through its rear corner holes; the board is fitted on the bench before pack-in. 2026-10-13 (later): the DFR1202 front lips and corner feet are removed so the OpenRB-150 slides straight in and out from behind along x with both shells on and only the cover off (check_v19_board_rear.json). Generator and checks: guide/print/rear-pack-v19/ (build_rear_pack_v19.py, check_*.json).

previous.note: V1.8 pack: BNO085 edge slot and tie shelf on the plate front.

previousV19.note: V1.9 pack as first released (DFR1202 lips and feet still in the OpenRB rear insertion path; board dropped in from above with the shells off).

rear_pack_cover.stl.description: Rear pack cover V1.8: 2 mm plate x -47..-45 following the body outline, inward lip over the DFR1202, four dia 2.2 holes for M2 x 6 into the body corner blocks.
rear_pack_cover.stl.retired: 2026-10-14: replaced by rear_frame.stl and rear_lid.stl (the frame carries the same cover plate, holes and lip); kept for the record, not drawn and not audited.

openrb-board-upright.stl.description: OpenRB-150 with trimmed header tails, standing upright in the rear pack (Layout L A): local = v - (-78.95, -12.71, -52.9); R = [[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[1,0,0]]; t = (-22.4, -13, -42). Components face -x (the converter), terminal block up, USB-C down. Not watertight (as the source); build_solids closes it.

imu_board.stl.description: BNO085 turned onto the rear pack front plate (Layout L I): local = v - (-57.53, -12.7, 3.57); R = [[0,0,1],[-1,0,0],[0,-1,0]]; t = (-18, 2.265, 30.9). Board plane x-z at y 0, components and STEMMA QT socket face +y, socket edge up.

imu_sh4_receiving.stl.description: JST-SH plug of the 4397 cable in the BNO085 socket, same rigid transform as imu_board.stl (plug enters from above).

jaw_frame.stl.description: Jaw frame V1.8 (2026-10-12): the 10/1 jaw frame (source 4.obj / ID4) with the lower lip pad (source q.obj / ID42) printed as part of it instead of glued into its pocket; a 0.9 mm bridge inset 1.5 mm inside the pad outline ties the pad bottom to the pocket floor. Geometry outside the pad box is identical to the 10/1 jaw (print/jaw-pad/merge_jaw_pad.json). Prints upright in the 10/1 jaw pose.

neck_pitch_ring.stl.description: V1.9 neck pitch ring: the 22 x 16.4 mm community ring (plate-05/17_community-102.stl) lengthened from 4.0 to 4.9 mm so its top face meets the ID13 case (the 4 mm ring left 0.91 mm). Audit: print/neck-ring/ring-audit.json. Released on the V1.8 Black plate (print/release-V1.8/); the earlier standalone ring release is withdrawn, print/release-V1.9-withdrawn-20261012/.

speaker_retainer.stl.description: Speaker retainer frame V1.9: holds the 1 mm foam ring and the speaker in the cap roof collar with two M2 x 6 into the cap pilots (axis [-0.248, 0, 0.969]). Prints flat on its speaker-side face.

clip_torso.stl.description: Torso wire clip V1.9: 2 mm tab under the S12-horn-025 head (right shell to ID12 idler, now M2 x 8) plus a 4.8 x 4.8 mm channel with a 2.4 mm slot for the 8-wire neck group. Rebuilt 2026-10-13 with rounded and chamfered channel edges (mesh check clean).

clip_bracket.stl.description: Bracket wire clip V1.9: tab under the S11-horn-040 head (pitch bracket to ID11 idler, now M2 x 8), channel on the head-pitch axis; rounded mouth corners r 2.4, 1.5 mm end chamfers.

clip_head.stl.description: Head wire clip V1.9: tab under the H-jaw_support-03 head (jaw support to lower shell boss, now M2.5 x 8); the group runs down its channel and out through its side window.

clip_cap.stl.description: Cap wire clip for the A7Z (2026-10-15): the V1.9 clip with a notch over the A7Z micro HDMI (0.6 mm clearance), one body, 214.1 mm3.

record.description: Cap wire clip V1.9: tab under the E-pi-04 head (Pi corner to cap rail, now M2 x 8); holds the group where it crosses the Pi top edge.

speaker.stl.description: Speaker (Adafruit 3351-type 4 ohm 3 W, 28 x 20 x 4 mm) tilted under the rear roof of the V1.9 cap in its collar, on a 1 mm foam ring; audio study position.

amplifier.stl.description: Adafruit MAX98357A I2S amplifier breakout with its right-angle 7-pin header (pins to +x, towards the Pi) and the 3.5 mm terminal block, hanging under the roof on the two cap posts, components up. The 100 kOhm GAIN-to-Vin resistor on its underside is not part of this solid (print/ext-v19/resistor_envelope_v19-world.stl).

rear_frame.stl.description: Rear converter box frame, layout F as released in V1.16 (2026-10-14; the V1.11 frame regenerated by print/back-plate/layout-F/build_f.py): the cover plate x -47..-45 with the cover outline, four dia 2.2 holes at (+-16.1, 26.0) and (+-16.1, -36.5) and the lip; a stepped box behind it with a square rim at x -59.1 and a constant cross-section (boards slide in from the rear): wide tier |y| <= 32.05, z -15.2..43 (two XL4015s, horizontal, IN ends -y, OUT ends +y) and narrow tier |y| <= 15.61, z -36.02..-15.2 (Adafruit 5991, terminal -y, USB-C +y); closed bottom; side windows at each terminal; USB-C slot in the +y wall (x -59.1..-49, z -31.16..-17.16); solid front plate (the V1.11 passage P1 is gone); wire notch A at the top-wall front edge (x -47.0..-49.8, y 3.2..12.4, rear corners r 1.0) and notch B in the cover-plate top edge (z 29.5 down to 28.5 over the same band, floor corners r 0.5) for the 7 V and 5 V pairs; eight XL4015 bosses (5.0 long from the seat at z 38.7 and -10.9, 4.2 at z 10.1 and 3.2 at z 17.7) and four 5991 bosses (3.0 standoff, 5.0 long; both upper bosses take hidden M2 x 10 cap screws), the two top XL4015 bosses at z 38.7 also take hidden M2 x 10 cap screws through the 7 V board, no hook notch, no tooth slots, no cap-screw ear bosses, and dia 4.4 driver lanes at the two lower cover screws. Features: print/back-plate/layout-F/features.json.
rear_frame.stl.addedOn: 2026-10-14 (layout F, V1.11); replaced 2026-10-14 evening by the V1.15 build and 2026-10-15 by the V1.16 build (four hidden cap screws, no tongues or hook; print/back-plate/layout-F/README.md)
rear_frame.stl.releaseNote: V1.16 candidate: bound into release-V1.16/manifest-V1.16.json by scripts/make_manifest.py; print gate rerun on this file before release (interference-audit/gate-receipt.json).

rear_lid.stl.description: Rear converter box cap, layout F as released in V1.16 (2026-10-15) with 3.0 mm screw-head floors (V1.19, 2026-10-15): rounded cap x -67.1..-59.1 with 1.2 mm walls carrying every rear-edge rounding (R 7.4 sides, 7.8 top, 4.3 step, 4.5 / 8.0 narrow tier), window notches at the side windows, and four hidden M2 x 10 screws, each driven from a dia 4.4 hole in the cap back down a dia 5.6 column to a 3.0 mm floor (the head seat and the M2 x 10 tip are those of V1.16; the floors grow forward, the +y low column is flattened 0.5 mm above the USB-C socket): two low columns on the 5991 upper hole axes (y +11.367, z -16.667) and (y -11.366, z -16.54) into the 5991 standoff bosses, and two top columns on the 7 V XL4015 top corner hole axes (y +-28.25, z 38.7), flattened inside the frame to |y| <= 30.6 and z <= 41.55, through the board into its frame bosses. The cap pushes straight on; no tongues, no hook, no screw ears; nothing outside the box outline.
rear_lid.stl.addedOn: 2026-10-14 (layout F, V1.11); replaced 2026-10-14 evening by the V1.15 build and 2026-10-15 by the V1.16 build (four hidden cap screws, no tongues or hook; print/back-plate/layout-F/README.md); 2026-10-15 V1.19: the four column floors thickened from 1.0 to 3.0 mm after the printed V1.17 cap's two low floors tore through on removal (Shawn, IMG_7004)
rear_lid.stl.releaseNote: V1.19 candidate: bound into release-V1.19/manifest-V1.19.json; print gate rerun on this file before release (interference-audit/gate-receipt.json).

xl4015_left.stl.description: XL4015 #1 (7 V rail, set point 6.80 V), layout F top tier: ROBOTIS mesh, horizontal, long axis y, component side toward -x, PCB mid-plane x -51.03, centre z 28.2; IN terminal at -y (side window in the -y wall), OUT at +y; four M2 x 6 into the frame bosses at y +-28.25, z 17.7 / 38.7. Key name kept for the guide content (top board).
xl4015_left.stl.releaseNote: Print gate pending for layout F (V1.11); see interference-audit/gate-receipt.json.

xl4015_right.stl.description: XL4015 #2 (5 V Pi lead), layout F middle tier: as xl4015_left at centre z -0.4; screws at y +-28.25, z -10.9 / 10.1. Key name kept for the guide content (middle board).
xl4015_right.stl.releaseNote: Print gate pending for layout F (V1.11); see interference-audit/gate-receipt.json.

pd5991.stl.description: Adafruit 5991 USB-C PD board, layout F bottom tier: PCB back face x -50.0 on 3.0 mm standoffs, 27.8 mm edge along y centred on y 0, z -34.32..-14.0; screw terminal faces -y (entries (-54.6, -13.2, -22.31) and (-54.6, -13.2, -25.81)) through the -y window, USB-C points +y through the +y wall slot; four M2 x 6 into the frame bosses at y +-11.37, z -31.9 / -16.6.
pd5991.stl.releaseNote: Print gate pending for layout F (V1.11); see interference-audit/gate-receipt.json.

shell_left.stl.description: Side shells V2.0 (print/v20-source/, built 2026-10-13; guide 2026-10-14 for release V1.12, White plate, with the V1.9 rear pack on the robot): one M2 x 6 straight down through the shell roof (dia 2.2 hole, dia 4.4 counterbore) into the V1.9 pack shoulder bar at x -21.5, y +20; the cross tunnel at x -38, z 35 filled flush; S12-horn-029..032 get dia 4.4 x 2.0 counterbores and take M2 x 4.
